description: Dataset for: Which Electric Vehicle Charging Station to Upgrade? Don´t Trust Your Judgment is a data set deposited in snd.su by its authors Ola Svenson, Inés Duce Gimeno (Stockholm University). Electric vehicles need to be charged. For maximal efficiency the charging times should be as short as possible. In the US charging stations are classified as Level 1 charging 5 - 10 miles/h , Level 2 25 miles/h and Fast DCFC stations 150 - 1000 miles/h. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 783954 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
